# Local bank import parsers

PDF.js 6.4.299 (Apache-2.0), read-excel-file 9.3.14 (MIT), fflate 0.8.3 (MIT) and saxen (MIT, exact version in package-lock.json). License texts are included alongside the bundles. No runtime CDN or document conversion service is used. Parser modules are loaded only when the relevant file type is selected.

`npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run build:import-parsers` recreates the checked-in assets. `vendor/import-parsers.json` records artifact sizes and SHA-256 checksums; CI rebuilds and rejects changes to the expected files. All dependencies and the esbuild 0.28.2 builder are pinned by the lockfile. The XLSX build adapter uses pinned internal read-excel-file modules and fflate's synchronous unzip inside a dedicated, terminable same-origin module worker. This deliberately avoids nested blob workers and preserves the existing CSP. Any parser upgrade requires rebuilding and rerunning the native file/browser regressions.

The import adapters only extract source data. A separate reproducible fflate 0.8.3 writer bundle supports scoped XLSX exports without formulas. Existing CSV validation, source-balance review, authorization, financial booking commands and database duplicate detection remain in place. XLSX formulas, macros, external links, hidden/merged data and ambiguous columns are rejected; populated sheets are never merged implicitly. ZIP metadata, expanded size, cell extents, file size, rows and PDF pages are bounded. Unknown or image-only PDFs require a separately reviewed CSV conversion; no OCR or inferred values are used.
